spawn_multi_process_test: spawn multiple processes to run a test method across ranks using torch multiprocessing
init_local_distributed_process_group: initialize a local distributed process group with nccl backend for single rank testing
ForkedPdb_debug: attach a debugger to a forked multiprocessing child process for debugging distributed runs
PGConfig_setup: create a PGConfig dataclass to configure backend, world size, and group size for process groups
init_pg_and_rank_and_launch_test: initialize a process group and rank then launch a test method in a spawned process
